description: Standalone single-page HTML dashboard at /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/pathway_to_20k.html showing Sentinel's progress toward the 20,000 assessed-MCP goal. The page must self-fetch JSON from registry_api endpoints (already running) and auto-refresh every 60 seconds via vanilla JavaScript fetch — NO external CDN dependencies, NO build step, NO frameworks. Required panels in this exact layout: (1) HEADLINE row across the top: large counter showing total servers in mcp_server_registry as numerator over fixed 20000 denominator, with a horizontal progress bar underneath colored teal; show percentage to 2 decimals. (2) ASSESSMENT FUNNEL panel below headline: horizontal bar chart with 6 stages each showing count and percentage of total — discovered (rows in mcp_discovery_candidates not yet in mcp_server_registry), promoted (in mcp_server_registry, no row in mcp_fingerprints), fingerprinted (has row in mcp_fingerprints, no row in mcp_signal_scores), scored (has row in mcp_signal_scores, no row in mcp_signal_enrichments), enriched (has row in mcp_signal_enrichments, no row in mcp_attestations), attested (has row in mcp_attestations). Each stage row shows stage name, count, percent of 20K goal, and a thin progress bar. (3) VELOCITY panel: three sparkline charts side by side showing per-hour additions over last 24 hours for: servers added to registry, fingerprints created, signal_scores created. Use simple SVG, no chart library. (4) ETA panel: at the trailing 24-hour average promotion rate, show estimated calendar days remaining to reach 20K. Show same calculation for fingerprints and full assessment (attestations) as separate ETA rows. (5) TIMESTAMP footer showing 'last refreshed' and a manual refresh button. STYLING: dark background #0e1116, accent teal #2dd4bf, monospace font for numbers, sans-serif for labels, match the visual aesthetic of /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/sentinel_status.html. The page must work standalone when opened directly in a browser pointed at the registry_api host. If registry_api endpoints needed for these counts do not yet exist, the directive permits adding them to registry_api.py as part of the same build — name them /api/pathway/totals, /api/pathway/funnel, /api/pathway/velocity, /api/pathway/eta. Each endpoint returns JSON with the corresponding numbers. Include a comment block at the top of the HTML file documenting which endpoints it expects. Do NOT modify dashboard.html or sentinel_status.html — this is a parallel page.
